description: Walk the Control nodes of the running game and report layout problems: Controls with no size, Controls outside the viewport or beyond their parent panel, text that needs more room than its rect (clipped) and overlapping labels. Returns the tree (path, class, rect, size, anchors, text) plus the issues, so a HUD can be checked without reading a screenshot.

node.description: Node in the running game: relative to the running scene (e.g. 'Player') or absolute (e.g. '/root/Main/Player'). Default: the running scene root.

name: game_ui_audit
title: Audit UI layout
